# 2D Game

A 2D game template using **[KAPLAY](https://kaplayjs.com/)** - a fun and simple JavaScript game library.

<Cards>
  <Card href="https://kaplayjs.com/" title="KAPLAY" description="Fun JavaScript game library." />
  <Card href="/docs/discord-activities" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-activities/2d-game
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

This template includes:

- KAPLAY game engine integration
- Sprite loading and animation
- Scene management
- Basic game loop structure

## Game Development

Build your game in the `/src/app` folder. KAPLAY provides:

<Files>
  <Folder name="src" defaultOpen disabled>
    <Folder name="app" note="Game code" disabled />
    <Folder name="api" note="Server routes" disabled />
  </Folder>
  <Folder name="config" defaultOpen disabled>
    <File name="vite.mjs" />
  </Folder>
  <File name=".env" />
</Files>

- Simple sprite handling
- Collision detection
- Scene transitions
- Sound effects

```bash
npm run deploy
```
